intro: A space for my photographs, the little details behind them, and my point of view. I mainly shoot on my phone, use a camera too, and edit photos and video.

kit.name: Phone first
kit.note: My main tool for photographs and everyday discoveries.

kit.name: Camera, too
kit.note: Another way to experiment with a frame and explore a different perspective.

kit.name: The edit
kit.note: I work with both photographs and video, shaping color, mood, and rhythm.

destinations.description: Green edges, still water, and the routes that feel like home.
destinations.headline: Where the water slows everything down.
destinations.introduction: Water keeps returning to these photographs—not as a destination, but as part of the everyday landscape around me.
story: I am drawn to the quiet structure of palms, banks, reflections, and narrow passages of light. The scene rarely asks for attention; it rewards waiting instead.
Together, these frames form a continuing record of familiar Kerala landscapes and the different moods they carry.
destinations.details: Made slowly, close to home, whenever weather and light turn an ordinary route into something worth keeping.
destinations.memory: The familiar can still surprise you when the light changes.

destinations.description: People, tide, and the last color of the day.
destinations.headline: The coast is never the same twice.
destinations.introduction: The shoreline gives every photograph a horizon, but the human moments are what make me stay.
story: Some frames are about scale; others are about two people sharing the edge of the day. I look for gestures that feel unarranged and for light that makes the ordinary briefly cinematic.
This is not a record of one trip. It is a growing coastal essay assembled across different visits and evenings.
destinations.details: Unhurried walks, changing weather, and enough time to watch the light disappear.
destinations.memory: The best coastal photographs often arrive after the plan has ended.

destinations.description: Blue hour, small lights, silhouettes, and details in the dark.
destinations.headline: When less light reveals a different story.
destinations.introduction: Night changes the way I look. Shapes become simpler, color becomes more deliberate, and small details begin to lead the frame.
story: These photographs collect the moments after daylight stops doing the obvious work. A silhouette, a lit doorway, or a line across a pink sky becomes enough.
The series is still growing. Its connection is a way of seeing rather than a single place or date.
destinations.details: Made around blue hour and after dark, with patience for slower, quieter frames.
destinations.memory: When the light falls away, attention becomes the most useful piece of equipment.
